systematic_finding: Every permissively-licensed result is a CODE repository. The permissive licence covers the tool, not the motion data, and the bundled data is either third-party from a CLOSED route (CMU, LAFAN1) or carries no stated data licence at all. No repository was found that supplies BOTH a walking BVH AND an authoritative data licence permitting commercial use.
root_cause: the fair1 joint naming (LeftUpLeg/LeftLeg/LeftFoot, Spine1-3) is the Mixamo/HumanIK convention. The large corpora using it are Mixamo (excluded by owner directive for AI/ML licence ambiguity) and academic sets under NC/ND terms. Permissive walking mocap in this exact skeleton is not, on this evidence, publicly available.
